scope: SVC-9 board 4, nominal filter input; documentary topology, not a complete ladder model

nodes.BUS: board 4 pin 4 and C27 negative terminal
nodes.BASE: C27 positive terminal, Q29 base and R54 left terminal
nodes.BOTTOM: R54 right terminal, R52 lower terminal, C24 positive terminal and R61 upper terminal
nodes.TAIL: Q29/Q30 common emitters and R60 upper terminal; Q28 collector is below R60

boundary_currents.Q29_base: positive current leaves BASE toward Q29 base; imposed in passive reference
boundary_currents.ladder_bottom: positive current leaves BOTTOM toward the remaining ladder; imposed in passive reference

excluded: R73 feedback path and board 4 pin 6
